long_term.record_line: Past GO SLOW days: 1 year later +13% on average (higher on 94%) vs +24% for any day (higher on 90%).
long_term.note: Graded on the price 1 year later over about 6 years. Those years overlap (about one independent result per year), and the rules were switched on/off using the same years, so read it as a guide, not proof.

forecast_reason.summary: Expected to fall about 4.8% in 30 days. Biggest reason: recent trend (-3.9%).
forecast_reason.telugu: 30 రోజుల్లో సుమారు 4.8% తగ్గవచ్చు. ప్రధాన కారణం: ఇటీవలి ధోరణి (-3.9%).

drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 5.8% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 0.8% lower in 30 days' time (Nov) than now (Oct).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is above the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day jump only half, so it starts 0.1% lower than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -11.7% to +4.1% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 5.3% on average at 30 days, vs 5.4% for "price stays the same" - it adds a little value. Direction right 69% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.

rules.english:
2026-10-29 Gold - SELL (score -2 of 6): If buying: Avoid buying now - wait for a dip.  If holding: Consider selling a part to book profit.
Why: Mainly because the 30-day forecast doesn't beat the holding cost and prices have been falling for weeks.
What would change it: Turns STRONG SELL if the price rises to Rs 1,47,852 (+13.0%); turns WAIT if the price falls to Rs 1,19,394 (-8.8%).
How sure: Medium. Past SELL days (1053 since 2017): lower 30 days later on 44% vs 39% of all days -> edge +6 points.
Price: Rs 1,30,843 per 10 g (Rs 1,34,768 with 3% GST); 7 days +0.1%, 30 days -4.0%. 30-day outlook Rs 1,24,579 (likely Rs 1,15,598 - Rs 1,36,258).
Saving for years: GO SLOW - The long-run signs are weak right now: keep the small regular buys, but avoid one big purchase now. Because the long wave is down (below the 200-day average). Not counted (its record disagrees): Price vs 3-year average.
rules.telugu:
2026-10-29 బంగారం - అమ్మండి (స్కోరు -2 / 6)
ఎందుకు: ముఖ్య కారణం: 30 రోజుల అంచనా నిల్వ ఖర్చును కూడా దాటడం లేదు మరియు కొన్ని వారాలుగా ధరలు తగ్గుతున్నాయి.
ఏది మారిస్తే మారుతుంది: ధర Rs 1,47,852 (+13.0%) కి పెరిగితే వెంటనే అమ్మండి; ధర Rs 1,19,394 (-8.8%) కి తగ్గితే వేచి ఉండండి.
నమ్మకం: మధ్యస్థం. గతంలో SELL రోజుల్లో (1053 రోజులు) 30 రోజుల తర్వాత 44% సార్లు ధర తగ్గింది; ఏ రోజైనా 39% (తేడా +6).
ధర: 10 గ్రాములకు Rs 1,30,843 (GST తో Rs 1,34,768); 7 రోజుల్లో +0.1%, 30 రోజుల్లో -4.0%. 30 రోజుల అంచనా Rs 1,24,579 (Rs 1,15,598 - Rs 1,36,258).
ఏళ్ల తరబడి దాచుకునేవారికి: నెమ్మదిగా కొనండి - దీర్ఘకాల సంకేతాలు ఇప్పుడు బలహీనంగా ఉన్నాయి: చిన్న క్రమమైన కొనుగోళ్లు కొనసాగించండి, ఇప్పుడు ఒకేసారి పెద్ద మొత్తం కొనకండి. కారణం: దీర్ఘకాల ధోరణి కిందికి ఉంది (200 రోజుల సగటు కింద).
